info.name: HustleHub+ API Tests
info.description:
Automated API tests for HustleHub+: authentication, RBAC, gigs, bookings, income, validation, sanitisation, Helmet and rate limiting.

Run in order (use the Collection Runner or Newman). Every request has pm.test assertions covering success and failure cases.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Registration, login and the protected profile route. Success AND failure cases.

exec: // unique emails on every run so the collection can be re-run
pm.test("User returned with role client", () => { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("client"); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/already exists/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/password/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/email/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/client or freelancer/i); });
pm.test("Message does not reveal whether the email exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/invalid email or password/i));

item.name: Login - unknown email gives same error (FAIL case)

exec: pm.test("Same message as wrong password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/invalid email or password/i));
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/required/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/token is required/i); });

item.name: 2. Gigs
item.description: Freelancer gig management with RBAC, ownership and validation.

exec: pm.test("Gig is active and owned by the freelancer", () => { pm.expect(g.status).to.eql("active"); pm.expect(g.freelancer).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("freelancerId")); });
pm.test("Price stored as a number", () => pm.expect(g.price).to.eql(350));
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/permission/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/price/i); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/required/i); });

item.name: Create gig - NoSQL operator as title (sanitisation)

exec: pm.test("Freelancer email is NOT exposed", () => j.data.forEach(g => pm.expect(g.freelancer).to.not.have.property("email")));

item.name: List gigs - search and category filter
List gigs - search with no match

exec: pm.test("Fields updated", () => { pm.expect(g.price).to.eql(400); pm.expect(g.title).to.eql("Premium logo design"); });
pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/own gigs/i); });

item.name: 3. Bookings, transactions and income
item.description: Client booking flow and freelancer income tracking.

exec: pm.test("Booking confirmed for the right amount", () => { pm.expect(j.booking.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(j.booking.amount).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("gigPrice"))); });

item.name: Book gig - gig does not exist

exec: pm.test("Shows the booking with gig and freelancer details", () => { pm.expect(j.count).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(j.data[0].gig.title).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.data[0].freelancer.name).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Total income equals the booked price", () => pm.expect(j.totalIncome).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("gigPrice"))));

item.name: Other freelancer income is zero (data isolation)
4. Deleting gigs
item.description: A booked gig cannot be deleted; an unbooked one can.

exec: pm.test("Has a clear error message", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string").and.match(/bookings/i); });

item.name: 5. Security (Helmet, sanitisation, rate limiting)
item.description: Run this folder last: the rate-limit test deliberately triggers the login limiter, which then blocks failed logins from your IP for 15 minutes.

item.name: NoSQL injection on login is rejected
Malformed JSON gets a JSON error
Rate limit - repeated failed logins get 429

exec: // Loops this request until the limiter answers 429 (max 30 tries).
pm.test("Limiter kicks in with 429 after repeated failures", () => pm.response.to.have.status(429));
pm.test("Response has a clear message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/too many/i));
